title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - SupplyGrid
description: A supply grid is a supply system of systematically connected artificial objects that can work as a supply system (oeo:OEO_00000200 'supply grid', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim; also 'grid', 'network'). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (electricity grid, transmission grid, distribution grid, gas grid, heating grid, control area) is carried in oeoClass.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SupplyGrid'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point, LineString or Polygon (RFC 7946). Not an OEO term: OEO has no direct geometry on artificial objects, so the NGSI-LD core location is used.

areaServed.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/areaServed'. The geographic area where the grid provides service. Not an OEO term.

oeoClass.description: Relationship. The specific OEO class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. OEO v2.14.0 declares 7 classes in the 'supply grid' hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: control area = oeo:OEO_00360004; distribution grid = oeo:OEO_00110020; electricity grid = oeo:OEO_00000143; gas grid = oeo:OEO_00020004; heating grid = oeo:OEO_00020005; supply grid = oeo:OEO_00000200; transmission grid = oeo:OEO_00110019.

hasPart.description: Relationship. GridComponent entities that are part of this supply grid (BFO 'has part').

hasSource.description: Relationship. Grid nodes (GridComponent) of this grid that work as entry points to the supply system (oeo:OEO_00000528 'has source').

hasSink.description: Relationship. Grid nodes (GridComponent) of this grid that work as extraction points of the supply system (oeo:OEO_00000527 'has sink').

ratedVoltage.description: Relationship. Rated voltage classes this grid operates on (oeo:OEO_00410068 subclasses: low, medium, high, extra high rated voltage).

gridOperator.description: Property. Name(s) of the grid operator(s) (TSO/DSO) responsible for this object. Not an OEO term: OEO declares 'power plant operator' but no grid operator class.
